_comment: Path-resolution config for the global /wiki-* tooling. llm-wiki-bootstrap is the MASTER tooling repo (no own wiki content). This config points cwd-based script resolution at the real agentic-design vault in the sibling workflows-core repo, so the tooling can be smoke-tested against live content while editing it here. The scripts read vault_root + wiki_topic from <cwd>/.claude/wiki-config.json; vault_root + wiki_topic resolve to <vault_root>/<wiki_topic> = the topic root containing _inbox/ and wiki/. Absolute path so resolution is identical regardless of cwd. Mirror of workflows-core/.claude/wiki-config.json.
